dataset: FDA Orange Book data files and Drugs@FDA data file

snapshot.orangeBook: Orange Book data files, September 2026 edition (EOBZIP_2026_09; files dated 2026-10-09, published 2026-10-13)

replacedInPlace: FDA replaces the two data files in place (Drugs@FDA each weekday, the Orange Book each month) and serves the code pages as they stand, so the pinned bytes are kept by the builder's --source-cache (files named by sha256), not re-fetched.
terms: Public data files published by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, used as a dated read-only snapshot. Not endorsed by FDA.
boundary: A point-in-time snapshot of public files, not the official record and not regulatory or clinical advice. What FDA changed after the snapshot date is not in it, and the Orange Book drops a patent or exclusivity once it has expired, so a state earlier than the snapshot may be missing.
